'''Foobba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who worked in the employ of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corporal Foobba appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] Equipment Commendations Vendor on [[Carrick Station]], though he was later relabeled as a Level 21 Equipment Vendor.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> he was removed from the game along with the rest of the Equipment Commendations Vendors. He was identical to [[Zanler]], the Equipment Commendations Vendor that appeared on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="TOR" />
